messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple pods in cluster us-west1-serve are being evicted due to ephemeral storage exhaustion on /var/tmp. Metrics show modelcache and runtime pods restarting. Paging oncall.
Emma (SRE): seeing a spike in node disk usage, pods getting Evicted (Reason: ""Exceeded ephemeral-storage""), a few CUDA init failures after restart. attaching quick outputs.
Raj (Serving): hitting 500s (runtime crash) and CUDA errors in logs for modelcache. This looks like runtime tries to restore large KV cache and runs out of tmpfs.
Lina (Oncall): I'm on it. stepping in as incident lead. @Emma can you paste df -h and kubectl get pods -o wide for the affected ns?
Emma (SRE): sure, grabbing now.
Emma (SRE): ```
$ kubectl get pods -n serve -o wide | grep Evicted
model-cache-7f8d9   0/1     Evicted   0          2m
runtime-serve-2gk5  0/1     Evicted   0          3m
logs-sidecar-1xq2   0/1     Evicted   0          3m

$ kubectl describe node ip-10-2-3-45 | egrep "Non-terminated Pods|Allocatable" -A2
Non-terminated Pods:         (50 in total)
  Namespace                  Name                     CPU Requests  CPU Limits  Memory Requests  Memory Limits  Ephemeral Storage Requests  Ephemeral Storage Limits
  serve                      model-cache-7f8d9        200m          1            512Mi            2Gi           40Gi                        -

$ df -h /var/tmp
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme0n1p1  200G  189G   0G 100% /var/tmp
```
Raj (Serving): logs show repeated modelcache checkpoint write and logrotate not keeping up. here's excerpt from runtime log before crash:
Emma (SRE): ```
[2026-03-15T10:22:01Z] ERROR runtime: cuda: cuInit failed: cannot allocate memory
[2026-03-15T10:22:02Z] WARN  modelcache: checkpoint write failed: no space left on device
[2026-03-15T10:22:05Z] INFO  runtime: OOM killer invoked, process killed: runtime-worker
```
Lina (Oncall): OK immediate mitigation plan
- reduce log verbosity for serve namespace (turn off DEBUG)
- roll modelcache to a smaller cache-size profile on affected nodes
- cordon + drain the most full node(s)
- scale up nodes with larger ephemeral storage class to shift load
@Raj please prepare a smaller model variant for fallback.
Raj (Serving): preparing smaller model variant (quantized) and will push a canary. ETA 12m.
Emma (SRE): cordoning node ip-10-2-3-45 now and draining pods to other nodes (ignore daemonsets):
```bash
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-3-45
kubectl drain ip-10-2-3-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-INC-9821 assigned to Lina (Oncall)
DeployBot: rolling canary deploy started: serve/runtime->v2.3.1-quantized canary (5% traffic)
Support Eng: Support seeing elevated 5xx for 2 customers on hosted API (latency spike and ~1-3% errors). CS Ops informed.
CS Ops: pinging customers on dedicated capacity to confirm impact. Drafting message: "We are observing transient 500s for some requests in us-west1; engineering is mitigating. We'll update within 30m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Emma (SRE): after drain, freed ~70GB on that node. df -h now shows 45G free.
Emma (SRE): nodes still show some pods restarting and one node with failing kubelet because of disk pressure — just restarted kubelet on ip-10-2-3-46.
Raj (Serving): canary looks stable so far. fallback model reduces memory footprint by ~60% for KV caches. no CUDA errors in canary logs.
Lina (Oncall): routing policy: shift 90% of traffic to canary-compatible nodes for now. applying graceful fallback policy in routing service.
Lina (Oncall): executing route update:
```json
PUT /routing/policy
{"from":"serve","policy":"fallback_quantized","weight":90}
```
Support Eng: confirmed error rate dropped from 2.8% -> 0.4% after routing change. pushing update to status page.
CS Ops: sent customer update to affected customers at 10:44 PST. kept tone: brief + ETA. awaiting replies.
Emma (SRE): cleanup actions: set up logrotate limit change for logs-sidecar to 100M, removed old checkpoints older than 14 days from /var/tmp/model-checkpoints on drained nodes.
Emma (SRE): commands run:
```bash
find /var/tmp/model-checkpoints -type f -mtime +14 -delete
kubectl patch configmap logrotate -n serve --patch '{"data":{"maxsize":"100M"}}'
```
Oncall Bot: automated alert: node ip-10-2-3-47 free disk <10% — queued scaling action to add two new nodes with 400G ephemeral.
Lina (Oncall): scaling up nodepool serve-large-ssd by +2 now.
DeployBot: nodes added and join successful.
Raj (Serving): switching canary->primary rollout paused, we keep traffic split until next 30m observe window passes.
Lina (Oncall): handoff plan: I'm sticking on for 15m then hand to Emma if stable. Next oncall (Emma) please monitor PD and routing, keep CS updated. Postmortem owner: @Raj. Timeline notes: start 10:22, cordon 10:28, canary 10:36, routing change 10:40, CS notified 10:44.
Emma (SRE): ack. will keep monitoring logs, especially cuda init errors and modelcache write failures.
Support Eng: will update status page with "mitigation in progress, reduced errors observed" and add note for dedicated customers to contact CS for details.
CS Ops: marking high-touch customers to follow up 1:1. capturing customer IDs and tagging incident: #cust-42, #cust-88.
Lina (Oncall): closing action items for now: 1) Raj to own postmortem and root cause (config & retention combos), 2) Emma to submit infra change to increase ephemeral FS defaults on serve nodes, 3) Support Eng/CS to follow up customers. Will reopen if errors rise.
Oncall Bot: PD-INC-9821 acknowledged by Lina. :white_check_mark:
Emma (SRE): leaving a note — consider adding preemptive disk pressure alert for /var/tmp > 85% with a runbook to auto-start drain/scale to avoid future session. will file infra ticket.
Raj (Serving): will add cache-size autoswitch when node storage low to prevent heavy checkpoint writes. adding as action in postmortem.
Lina (Oncall): handing off to Emma at 10:50. Emma, you good to take until full cooling period?
Emma (SRE): taking over. will keep watch for 60m and then close incident if stable. :thumbsup:
